## DataProxy

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.QuantScript.Api.DataProxy</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.QuantScript/Api/DataProxy.cs:13](../../../../src/Meridian.QuantScript/Api/DataProxy.cs#L13).

Async-first façade over IQuantDataContext for ergonomic script use. Synchronous methods are retained as compatibility wrappers for existing scripts. Important: Sync members must only be called from a background thread (never the UI thread) to avoid deadlocks. Compilation.ScriptRunner ensures scripts run via Task.Run.

## RoslynScriptCompiler

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.QuantScript.Compilation.RoslynScriptCompiler</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.QuantScript/Compilation/RoslynScriptCompiler.cs:26](../../../../src/Meridian.QuantScript/Compilation/RoslynScriptCompiler.cs#L26).

Compiles QuantScript (.csx) source files using the Roslyn scripting API. Results are cached by SHA-256 of source text to avoid redundant recompilation; the cache is bounded (see QuantScriptOptions.MaxCachedCompilations) so retained Roslyn compilation graphs cannot accumulate without limit. When unsafe scripts are disabled the compiler applies a best-effort advisory guard against File/Network/Process/Reflection usage. That guard is a source-level denylist, not a security sandbox — see QuantScriptOptions.EnableUnsafeScripts.

```csharp
public sealed class RoslynScriptCompiler : IQuantScriptCompiler
```
